, the ZF-PSIC receiver is optimal in terms of SER performance and ZF-SIC receiver without optimal ordering is sub-optimal in terms of SER.

the analytical SER performance bound of M-QAM ZF-SIC MIMO system can be obtained from the analytical SER expressions of M-QAM systems with ZF and ZF-PSIC receiver.
the SER of ZF-SIC receiver can be bounded by our proposed SER expressions.
the SER of ZF-SIC receiver is between the SER of ZP-PSIC and ZF-PSIC receiver.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the ZF-PSIC receiver is the best choice for high data rate applications, while the ZF-SIC receiver is a good compromise between complexity and performance.
, the SER of ZF-PSIC receiver is always better than that of the ZF-SIC receiver without optimal ordering, and the SER gap is increasing with the number of transmit antennas.
the ZF-SIC receiver is a promising candidate for MIMO system with M-QAM, and the SER performance bound of ZF-SIC can be easily obtained by the ZF-PSIC and ZF receivers.
